title: GIANT RIP OFF
text: GIANT RIP OFF. What a pretty picture, right? What you will receive is, more or less, just fraud. I got only three bulbs and what may have been a piece of a root about 1/2 “ long, not viable for growth. That about $6 each for one very small, gnarly old root that is unlikely to ever propagate. Don’t waste your time.

product_metadata.title: Caladium Red Flash,(6 Bulbs) Thrives in Heat and Humidity, Elephant Ears
description: A sturdy, upright caladium with deep green leaves and brilliant red centers that are decorated with pink dots. Red Flash grows in sun or shade, so it's a great choice for any area where you want a splash of bright color. As with all caladiums, it grows best in warm soil and appreciates consistent moisture. Good in Containers All Summer Color for Sun or Shade Thrives in Heat and Humidity
